bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; echo ACTION=TUMBLR_RUNTIME_INSPECT; echo PWD=$PWD; printf 'SOURCE_SHA='; git rev-parse HEAD; printf 'BRANCH='; git branch --show-current; if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo GIT_CLEAN=YES; else echo GIT_CLEAN=NO; fi; test -e dist/current && echo DIST_CURRENT=YES || echo DIST_CURRENT=NO; test -f tumblrkit/appserve.py && echo APPSERVE=YES || echo APPSERVE=NO; for p in /proc/[0-9]*/cmdline; do if tr '\0' ' ' < "$p" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'tumblrkit.appserve serve'; then echo RUNNING_APP_PID=${p#/proc/}; fi; done; if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then ss -ltn | grep -E '(:8081[[:space:]]|:8081$)' | sed 's/^/PORT_8081=/'; fi; systemctl --user --no-pager --plain list-units --all --type=service 2>/dev/null | grep -i tumblr | sed 's/^/USER_UNIT=/' || true; systemctl --no-pager --plain list-units --all --type=service 2>/dev/null | grep -i tumblr | sed 's/^/SYSTEM_UNIT=/' || true; echo INSPECT_DONE=YES
